_about: Flow Day (US) copy — edit freely, keep the keys. pillars: the 60 day signs; stems: element, image, traits; themes: what a day means, by its Ten God and tone (xi = the day's element fuels you, ji = it drains you; neutral uses xi), 3 variants each, rotated by date; oracle: the Daily Oracle (100 lots, toss texts, 9 topics × 1–5 stars); tenGods: [friendly name, classical name]; levels: the five day levels; seasons: the 24 solar terms; pairKinds/pairs: friend paintings; elements: colors and what fuels you. Art lives in ../art/.

pillars.name: Oak by Winter Water
pillars.intro: Bookish and easy to like. Every new thing you learn makes you surer of yourself.

pillars.name: Plum Blossom in Snow
pillars.intro: Tough, patient and practical. You bloom in the cold, when everyone else has gone quiet.

pillars.name: Sunrise in the Spring Woods
pillars.intro: Curious, upbeat and full of energy. You bring the morning with you wherever you go.

pillars.name: Lantern on a Flowering Branch
pillars.intro: Imaginative, with a look all your own. Even when you're quiet, you give off light.

pillars.name: Mountain with a Hidden Spring
pillars.intro: Steady and generous. You can hold a lot — problems, secrets, people — and keep it all safe.

pillars.name: Sunny Fields in Early Summer
pillars.intro: Warm, lively and resourceful. You meet things head-on and usually find a way.

pillars.name: Sword Tempered in Summer Fire
pillars.intro: Polished and principled. You keep your standards, and pressure only makes you sharper.

pillars.name: Gem in the Sand
pillars.intro: Calm and seasoned on the outside, finely tuned on the inside. You notice everything.

pillars.name: River Rushing from Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Quick-minded with real staying power. You learn fast, and your world keeps getting wider.

pillars.name: Dew on an Autumn Morning
pillars.intro: Clear-headed with sharp instincts. You get things done cleanly, without fuss.

pillars.name: Tree on an Autumn Ridge
pillars.intro: Down-to-earth and low-key, with deep reserves. People feel safe around you.

pillars.name: Blossoms on a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Kind, intuitive and calm inside. You never push, and you still carry weight.

pillars.name: Sunrise over a Frozen Lake
pillars.intro: Upright and gracious. You play fair — and you can warm up the coldest room.

pillars.name: Lamplight in a Snowy Window
pillars.intro: Unflashy, with a plan you keep to yourself. Your life runs on quiet good judgment.

pillars.name: Mountain in the Spring Forest
pillars.intro: A commanding presence, born to lead. When it counts, you make the call.

pillars.name: Field of Spring Sprouts
pillars.intro: Busy on the surface, calm underneath. The more there is to do, the more organized you get.

pillars.name: Sword Rising from a Spring Lake
pillars.intro: Strong presence, a mind of your own. The harder it gets, the more you want to win.

pillars.name: Gem on a Sun-Warmed Stone
pillars.intro: Gracious and easy to like. You weigh things carefully — sometimes twice, sometimes ten times.

pillars.name: Lake Holding the Summer Sky
pillars.intro: Bright and easygoing. You know how to build a good life, and everyone around you feels it.

pillars.name: Rain on Dry Ground
pillars.intro: Big-hearted and giving. When you help, you help exactly where it matters.

pillars.name: Tree on a Windy Cliff
pillars.intro: Disciplined and decisive. Pressure makes you better — you stand tall and hold your ground.

pillars.name: Osmanthus under the Autumn Moon
pillars.intro: Precise and composed. Your craft shows in the details.

pillars.name: Sun Setting into Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Grounded and deep. Your warmth shows up in what you do, not in what you say.

pillars.name: Lantern on a Winter River
pillars.intro: Honest and reserved. You're quiet, and people trust you anyway — instantly.

pillars.name: Mountain on a Snowy Night
pillars.intro: Practical, steady, smart with money. The higher the stakes, the more reliable you get.

pillars.name: Field Resting in Winter
pillars.intro: Humble and practical, a natural at living well. You know what's worth keeping.

pillars.name: Sword in Stone, Spring Woods
pillars.intro: A sharp eye for opportunity. Once you see it, you move.

pillars.name: Jade Hairpin among Flowers
pillars.intro: Elegant and nimble-minded. You're always first to spot an opening.

pillars.name: Ocean at Spring Tide
pillars.intro: Big presence, big ambitions. Rough water just gets you going.

pillars.name: Sunshower in Early Summer
pillars.intro: Gentle and thoughtful. People are drawn to you, and you're easy to be around.

pillars.name: Tree on a Summer Plain
pillars.intro: Clever and magnetic. People notice you, and your ideas are usually a step ahead.

pillars.name: Vine on Late-Summer Earth
pillars.intro: Grounded and results-minded. You can put down roots anywhere.

pillars.name: Sun on an Autumn Evening
pillars.intro: Quick and perceptive. You read the room, and you're funny without overstepping.

pillars.name: Candle in an Autumn Window
pillars.intro: Refined taste and a nose for opportunity. You know how to live.

pillars.name: Mountain in Late Autumn
pillars.intro: Solid and quiet. You keep your word — you're the one everyone counts on.

pillars.name: Field by Early Winter Water
pillars.intro: Steady and fair, with a fine sense of proportion. You can adapt to almost anything.

pillars.name: Sword in a Cold Spring
pillars.intro: Bright and lively. There's a spark in how you talk and work, and new ideas keep coming.

pillars.name: Uncut Jade in Winter Earth
pillars.intro: You don't say much, but you see deep — into people, and into things.

pillars.name: River through the Spring Woods
pillars.intro: Talented and fun-loving. You know how to enjoy life, and the ideas never stop.

pillars.name: Spring Dew
pillars.intro: Fresh and quick-witted. Your talent hides in the details, and you always know where the line is.

pillars.name: Oak on a Rainy Riverbank
pillars.intro: You think big and give freely. Every year, you stand on firmer ground.

pillars.name: Flower Climbing the Rocks
pillars.intro: Bright and expressive. Walk into a room, and you're seen.

pillars.name: Midsummer Noon Sun
pillars.intro: Warm, bold and quick to act. Your energy fills the place.

pillars.name: Lamp on a Country Path
pillars.intro: Reliable and steady. If you say it, you'll do it.

pillars.name: Autumn Hill with a Clear Spring
pillars.intro: Witty and playful, with a real gift for enjoying life.

pillars.name: Fields at Harvest
pillars.intro: You know good things when you see them. Your life has real flavor.

pillars.name: Old Sword in the Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Plain-spoken and quiet, with principles you won't bend. People rely on you.

pillars.name: Pearl in a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Graceful and perceptive, with a real creative streak.

pillars.name: Ocean Rising on a Winter Night
pillars.intro: Bold and fearless, and loyal to the core.

pillars.name: Drizzle on Winter Fields
pillars.intro: Quiet and low-key, with a mind firmly your own. You carry weight without making noise.

pillars.name: Great Tree in the Early Spring Forest
pillars.intro: Confident and sure of yourself. You were made to grow upward.

pillars.name: Orchid after Spring Rain
pillars.intro: Fresh, lovely and easy to be around. People are simply drawn to you.

pillars.name: Sun Breaking through Rain Clouds
pillars.intro: Gentle and cultured, with a head full of wonderful ideas.

pillars.name: Kiln Fire in Early Summer
pillars.intro: You don't give up, and your drive is contagious.

pillars.name: High Mountain under Blazing Sun
pillars.intro: Passionate and strong under pressure. You stand out wherever you go.

pillars.name: Golden Wheat in Late Summer
pillars.intro: Hardworking and never one to quit. Step by step, you build a full life.

pillars.name: Sword on an Autumn Cliff
pillars.intro: Direct, unbreakable, and fiercely loyal.

pillars.name: Diamond under the Autumn Moon
pillars.intro: Exacting, with high standards — and fiercely loyal to your people.

pillars.name: Lake Ringed by Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Kind-hearted, intuitive, and very good with money.

pillars.name: Fine Rain on a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Calm on the surface, with real depth of heart and vision.

5.line: One of your best days. Go for it.

4.line: Things flow. A good day to move forward.

3.line: An even day. Keep a normal pace.

2.line: Some friction. Double-check and go slow.

1.line: Keep it simple. Rest and skip big moves.

xi.title: A Day for Recognition
xi.line: Structure works for you. Bosses, rules and reputation are on your side.
do: Show your work to someone senior
Follow the process — it pays off

xi.title: A Day to Earn Trust
xi.line: Reliability gets noticed today, so let your steady, by-the-book work speak for you.
do: Deliver exactly what you promised
Update your manager without being asked

xi.title: A Day to Set Your Rhythm
xi.line: Routines and clear rules feel good today, so give your life a little more structure.
do: Plan tomorrow before bed
Tidy up one messy system

ji.title: A Day of Expectations
ji.line: Other people's expectations weigh more than usual. Meet them, but don't twist yourself to fit.
do: Get the must-dos done early
Ask what's actually expected

ji.title: A Day to Know Your Limits
ji.line: Duties pile up and the bar feels high, so focus on what truly needs you.
do: Rank today's obligations by deadline
Say plainly what you can deliver

ji.title: A Day to Stay Composed
ji.line: Rules and feedback may feel tight today; stay calm, steady and true to yourself.
do: Hear feedback, then take a breath
Keep your replies short and polite
dont: Bend your values to fit in
Argue the rules in the moment

xi.title: A Day to Push Through
xi.line: Pressure turns into drive. You can move something big today.
do: Tackle the hardest task first
Make the bold call
dont: Waste the momentum on small stuff

xi.title: A Day to Rise to It
xi.line: A tough challenge brings out your best, so step up and own the hard thing.
do: Volunteer for the stretch assignment
Set a tight, real deadline

xi.title: A Day to Break Through
xi.line: Your energy is strong and focused, perfect for clearing an obstacle that's been in your way.
do: Name the obstacle, then tackle it
Push your workout a little harder

ji.title: A High-Pressure Day
ji.line: Pressure is high and patience is thin. Pace yourself and pick your battles.
do: Set one clear boundary
Take a real break mid-day

ji.title: A Day to Protect Your Energy
ji.line: Demands come from every side today, so save your strength for what truly matters.
do: Drop one nonessential task
Eat and sleep on schedule

ji.title: A Day to Keep Cool
ji.line: Tension runs high and tempers flare easily; slow down and respond rather than react.
do: Count to ten before replying
Step outside for fresh air

xi.title: A Day to Be Supported
xi.line: Good for learning, resting and letting people help you.
do: Read, study or take a class
Ask a mentor for advice

xi.title: A Day to Recharge
xi.line: Gentle energy surrounds you today, perfect for restoring yourself and soaking up good advice.
do: Go to bed early tonight
Spend time somewhere calm

xi.title: A Day to Grow Your Skills
xi.line: Learning comes easily today, and the right teacher or resource may be close at hand.
do: Start that course or tutorial
Thank someone who taught you

ji.title: A Slow, Heavy Day
ji.line: Comfort pulls at you and things move slowly. Rest is fine — just don't stall on what matters.
do: Do one thing you've been putting off
Keep plans simple

ji.title: A Day to Get Moving
ji.line: It's easy to stay in your comfort zone today, so take one small, real step forward.
do: Start before you feel ready
Set a timer for twenty minutes

ji.title: A Day to Trust Yourself
ji.line: Help is welcome, but today calls for leaning on your own judgment a little more.
do: Make one decision yourself
Handle one small task solo
dont: Hand off what's yours to do

xi.title: A Day for Deep Thinking
xi.line: Your mind wants quiet. Good for research, strategy and time alone.
do: Block two hours of focus time
Journal or plan next month

xi.title: A Day for Fresh Insight
xi.line: Unusual ideas and quiet hunches are sharp today, so follow your curiosity somewhere new.
do: Explore a topic outside your field
Sketch an unconventional solution
dont: Dismiss a strange idea too fast

xi.title: A Day for Solitude
xi.line: Time on your own restores you today, so protect it and let your thoughts settle.
do: Turn off notifications for a while
Take yourself on a solo outing

ji.title: A Restless, Inward Day
ji.line: You may feel out of sync with people. Keep to yourself a little, and don't read too much into things.
do: Take a walk alone
Write it down before you say it
dont: Make big decisions on a hunch

ji.title: A Day to Stay Grounded
ji.line: Your mind may spin and wander today, so lean on simple routines to stay steady.
do: Stick to your usual routine
Do something with your hands

ji.title: A Day to Check Your Read
ji.line: Signals from others may feel confusing today, so ask before you assume anything.
do: Ask a clarifying question
Talk it through with someone trusted

xi.title: A Day for Allies
xi.line: Friends and teammates have your back. Collaborate.
do: Team up on a shared project
Reach out to an old friend
dont: Go it alone out of pride

xi.title: A Day for Teamwork
xi.line: Shared effort goes further today, so lean on your team and lift them too.
do: Split a big task with a peer
Give a teammate public credit
dont: Insist on doing it your way

xi.title: A Day to Reconnect
xi.line: Your people are close at hand today, a great time to strengthen your circle.
do: Plan a hangout with friends
Join a group or club activity

ji.title: A Crowded Day
ji.line: Everyone wants a piece of the same thing. Share the credit, guard your time.
do: Be clear about who does what
Protect one hour for yourself

ji.title: A Day to Hold Your Ground
ji.line: Peers may crowd your space or plans today, so stay friendly but keep what's yours.
do: State your share clearly
Keep your own priorities first

ji.title: A Day to Run Your Race
ji.line: Comparison is tempting today, so focus on your own pace and let others run theirs.
do: Track only your own progress
Mute feeds that stir envy

xi.title: A Competitive Day
xi.line: A little rivalry sharpens you. Go after it — and play fair.
do: Compete for what you want
Network with confidence

xi.title: A Day to Go for It
xi.line: Healthy competition fires you up today, so put yourself forward and aim high.
do: Apply, pitch or put your name in
Set a personal best to beat

xi.title: A Day to Make Your Move
xi.line: Bold, social energy works for you today, so speak up and grow your network.
do: Introduce yourself to someone new
Ask directly for what you want

ji.title: A Day to Guard Your Wallet
ji.line: Spending and rivalry run high. Stay sharp and watch your money.
do: Double-check shared money
Sleep on big purchases

ji.title: A Day to Protect What's Yours
ji.line: Others may reach for your time, money or credit today, so hold steady and stay clear.
do: Put agreements in writing
Keep valuables close

ji.title: A Day to Skip the Contest
ji.line: Rivalry may feel personal today, but you don't need to win every round.
do: Let one argument go
Stick to your spending plan
dont: Spend to keep up with others

xi.title: A Day of Ease
xi.line: Relaxed and creative. Make something you enjoy.
do: Cook, create or play
Say yes to a small pleasure

xi.title: A Day to Savor
xi.line: Simple pleasures feel extra good today, so slow down and enjoy what's in front of you.
do: Eat a meal without screens
Share a treat with someone

xi.title: A Day for Playful Ideas
xi.line: Creativity flows when you keep it light, so make something just for the joy of it.
do: Doodle, write or play music
Try a fun new recipe

ji.title: A Lazy-Feeling Day
ji.line: Comfort is tempting and focus is soft. Enjoy it, but finish one real thing.
do: Pick one task and finish it
Move your body

ji.title: A Day of Gentle Effort
ji.line: Motivation runs low today, so set a small goal and let that be enough.
do: Break work into tiny steps
Reward yourself after one task

ji.title: A Day to Keep It Balanced
ji.line: Indulgence is tempting today, so enjoy a little, then get back to what matters.
do: Drink water and take a walk
Set a clear stopping time

xi.title: A Day to Speak Up
xi.line: Ideas are flowing and you want to be heard. Go for it.
do: Pitch a bold idea
Write, post or perform

xi.title: A Day to Share Your Voice
xi.line: Your words land with energy today, so say what you think and make it count.
do: Lead the meeting discussion
Post the thing you've drafted

xi.title: A Day to Break the Mold
xi.line: Your inventive streak is strong today, so question the usual way and try your own.
do: Rethink one outdated process
Start a creative side project
dont: Shelve an idea for being unusual

ji.title: A Day to Mind Your Words
ji.line: You'll want to say exactly what you think. Say it kindly — or sleep on it.
do: Vent in a journal first
Choose your audience

ji.title: A Day to Listen First
ji.line: Your opinions run hot today, so hear people out before you share yours.
do: Let others finish speaking
Ask before giving feedback

ji.title: A Day to Keep It Diplomatic
ji.line: Rules and authority may irritate you today, so choose tact over bluntness and protect your relationships.
do: Reread messages before sending
Frame critiques as suggestions

xi.title: A Payoff Day
xi.line: Steady effort pays off. Good for money and practical work.
do: Handle bills, budgets and admin
Finish what you started

xi.title: A Day for Steady Progress
xi.line: Consistent, practical work goes far today, so put your energy into tasks that build value.
do: Knock out your top priority
Update your budget or tracker

xi.title: A Day to Get Organized
xi.line: Order brings real satisfaction today, perfect for sorting finances, files and plans.
do: Clear your inbox or desk
Review a recurring subscription

ji.title: A Day of Small Leaks
ji.line: Money and time slip away in small ways. Keep a tight grip on the details.
do: Check your accounts
Say no to one extra commitment

ji.title: A Day to Mind the Details
ji.line: Small slips can add up today, so slow down and double-check the basics.
do: Proofread before you submit
Review receipts and charges

ji.title: A Day to Spend Wisely
ji.line: Little expenses and time drains add up today, so stay mindful of where things go.
do: Write down what you spend
Cancel one unused subscription
dont: Buy just because it's on sale

xi.title: A Lucky-Break Day
xi.line: Unexpected chances and connections show up. Stay open.
do: Network, or say yes to an invite
Try a side project

xi.title: A Day to Say Yes
xi.line: Surprises and new faces bring fresh possibilities today, so keep your door open.
do: Accept a last-minute invite
Follow up with a new contact

xi.title: A Day to Explore
xi.line: Curiosity serves you well today, so wander a little and see what turns up.
do: Try a new spot or route
Pitch a small creative venture

ji.title: A Day of Temptations
ji.line: Shiny offers and easy money call. Most aren't what they seem today.
do: Ask one more question before saying yes
Keep your budget in view
dont: Spend the windfall before it lands

ji.title: A Day for Fine Print
ji.line: Deals that look easy may hide strings today, so slow down and check before committing.
do: Research before you sign up
Get a second opinion
dont: Invest in what you don't understand

ji.title: A Day to Stay Focused
ji.line: Distractions and side offers pull at you today, so stick with what you've already started.
do: Finish one plan before another
Keep a spending limit in mind

Wood.fuels: Growth and fresh starts: plants, morning walks, learning something new.

Fire.fuels: Warmth and energy: sunlight, movement, being around people.

Earth.fuels: Stability: routines, cooking, home, steady habits.

Metal.fuels: Clarity: decluttering, clear rules, crisp air, finishing things.

Water.fuels: Rest and depth: sleep, reading, water, quiet time.

strength.strong: You run strong: plenty of your own element. You do best when you spend that energy — create, earn, take on structure.
strength.weak: You run gentle: you rely on support. You do best with rest, learning and people who have your back.

match.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. Your signs combine — together, you both feel more like yourselves.

same.text: You are both the {me}. Same instincts, same rhythm — the kind of pair that goes the distance.

lift.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. You hold them up, and they give your care somewhere to go.

lifted.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. They hold you up — around them, you stand a little taller.

push.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. You push them forward. When it grinds, give them room.

pushed.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. They push you forward. Get through the friction, and no one will know you better.

sheng.name: Yes
sheng.line: One up, one down — the oracle agrees this is your lot.

xiao.name: Laughing blocks
xiao.line: Both face up — ask again, a little more clearly.

yin.name: Not yet
yin.line: Both face down — breathe, then toss again.

jiao.ask: Toss the moon blocks to confirm this is your lot.
jiao.rules: Up to three tosses. One up and one down means yes. Three "not yet" in a row means it's time to rephrase.
jiao.closed: The blocks didn't say yes today. Let it rest — come back tomorrow.

1.title: Heaven and Earth Begin
verse: Heaven and earth open, a good beginning
The day is right, everything in place
Drawing this is no small thing
Those who walk true are called forward
1.reading: The verse sees a fresh start with everything already in place, and it favors people who act plainly and honestly. Bring out an idea you have been holding back today and say it straight.

2.title: The Whale Before the Gate
verse: The whale, not yet a dragon, keeps the river
Do not try to rise too high yet
One day its shape will change
And it will leap the Dragon Gate
2.reading: You are still building strength in familiar waters, and pushing for the leap too early would cost you. Pick one piece of work in front of you today and do it thoroughly, saving your energy for later.

3.title: Swallow in the Rain
verse: Through wind and rain, heading home
Like a swallow on the wing
Carrying mud to build a nest
The nest falls, and needs mud again
3.reading: The verse sees hard work that keeps coming undone because it is spread too thin. Choose the one thing that matters most today, make it solid, and let the rest wait.

4.title: The Old Mirror Made Whole
verse: An ancient mirror, whole once more
What was parted comes back together
The house takes on a new look
Blessings carry on to those who follow
4.reading: Something that was broken off is ready to reconnect, and old ties may hold new openings. Reach out today to a friend or former coworker you have not talked to in a while.

5.title: Digging for a Spring
verse: Boring into grassland, searching for a spring
Dig as you might, water won't come
Then, unplanned, a true friend appears
Hand in hand, you climb the sky
5.reading: Forcing one approach is wearing you out, while help may be waiting somewhere you are not looking. Stop grinding on the same spot today and talk your problem through with someone new.

6.title: Beneath the Eagle's Cliff
verse: Settling low beneath the cliff
Where the eagle keeps its nest
It takes a steady, sturdy heart
Plan well, and the wide world opens
6.reading: The verse honors someone willing to start low and carry real weight, planning ahead until there is room to move. Take on a task others are avoiding today and do it carefully.

7.title: Mud on the Mountain Road
verse: Wandering past barrier after barrier
Wading through mud to cross the mountains
Hoping to find work in distant places
A thousand miles, and still not home
7.reading: You may feel pulled to keep searching elsewhere, but restless motion is wearing you down right now. Hold off on any sudden change of direction today and steady the work already in your hands.

8.title: Pines Through Every Season
verse: Pines and cypress thick and thriving
Rain, snow, wind and frost can't harm them
One day, suddenly, they're put to use
Grown into beams that hold a house
8.reading: Your steady growth through pressure is quietly turning into real strength. Instead of rushing to prove yourself today, spend an hour sharpening a skill you will need later.

9.title: The Moon at Its Height
verse: Please leave aside the private scheme
Bring this to the fair-minded instead
A clear heart, shining clean
Like the bright moon high at center sky
9.reading: The verse asks for a clear, open heart, bright and plain as the full moon. If there is a disagreement today, put it openly on the table and speak fairly.

10.title: Holding a Lamp, Seeking Fire
verse: Priceless jade lies hidden in your stone
Yet you go searching distant lands
Like holding a lamp and hunting fire
Better to stop and look close
10.reading: What you are chasing far away may already be within reach. Take stock today of the skills, tools and people you already have before looking anywhere else.

11.title: A Guide on the Road
verse: You hope for something rare and fine
But family matters keep you busy
In the end you hit the mark
A guide will lead you to good ground
11.reading: Small obligations have slowed you down, but someone with experience can help you find the way. When you get stuck today, ask a mentor or senior colleague one clear question.

12.title: The Turn Is Near
verse: Hard times leave, good times step close
A wise friend comes down the mountain
Word comes with the tiger and hare
Set your mind, and the rush turns calm
12.reading: The verse sees a turn from hard to easier that is only a step away. If something small goes wrong today, hold off on judging it and try a different angle.

13.title: The Golden Belt
verse: Raised in a house of plenty
Fine things all around you
Given a purple robe and golden belt
Your name travels across four seas
13.reading: You have a real foundation to stand on, and the chance to be recognized for it. Show one of your strengths openly today, and pair it with an easy, humble manner.

14.title: Crane Out of the Cage
verse: Like a crane leaving its cage
Free of the bars, every road opens
North, south, east, west, nothing blocks
You may climb straight to the clouds
14.reading: Something that has been holding you in is ready to be let go, and the way opens once it is. Drop one old habit or stale task today and use that space for what you actually want to do.

15.title: Birds Without a Nest
verse: The traveler swallows a bitter day
If trouble flares, don't step close
The nest is broken, the birds unsheltered
Seek the deep woods and settle safe
15.reading: You may be carrying a grievance that is hard to swallow, and reacting now would only scatter you further. Skip the argument today, find a quiet place to steady yourself, and make your case later.

16.title: Jade in the Dust
verse: Worried brows begin to ease
Gladness breaks through the clouds
Like jade hidden in the dirt
A skilled hand lifts it into light
16.reading: Your worries are starting to clear, and good work of yours is waiting to be found. Polish a piece of your work today and show it to someone who knows the field.

17.title: A Painted Cake
verse: Don't listen to idle gossip
Keep your own quiet practice, morning and night
If wild talk is taken as truth
Can a painted cake ease hunger
17.reading: Rumors and empty promises are not worth building on. Check any news you hear today before acting on it, and put your effort into what is real.

18.title: Sun Sets, Moon Rises
verse: The golden sun sinks, the moon climbs east
Day and night turning since ancient times
Seekers of every path do well
Every trade follows its own heart
18.reading: Like day and night, things are moving in their natural rhythm, and your path fits within it. Work your plan at your own pace today, do your part well, and let the rest unfold.

19.title: Boat at the Rapids
verse: Launching a boat at the rapids' edge
Why push into wind and waves
If you want a safe, calm crossing
Wait for the water to settle
19.reading: You are facing fast, unsettled water, and rushing through it now adds risk. If something urgent and tangled lands on you today, pause and gather the facts before you move.

20.title: Clear Skies After Spring Rain
verse: After long spring rain, the sky clears
Sun and moon grow slowly bright
Old troubles fade, new things take hold
Watch, and leap the Dragon Gate
20.reading: A long gray stretch is lifting, making room to close the old and open the new. Wrap up one lingering task today, then start the next thing with a free hand.

21.title: Dragon and Serpent Meet
verse: Yin and yang join as they should
Two families meet in quiet joy
See the dragon and serpent come together
Bears enter dreams, the circle complete
21.reading: The verse sees two sides fitting well together, each completing the other. It is a good day to talk through a partnership or settle an agreement, and to share a good meal with someone close.

22.title: Rain on Dry Fields
verse: In drought, the fields lie parched
Then sweet rain falls, soaking through
Flowers, fruit and grass drink deep
Now you know what rain is worth
22.reading: If you are in a dry stretch, help may arrive in a form you did not expect. Notice who is offering a hand today, and look for one small way to help someone else too.

23.title: Reaching for the Moon Laurel
verse: Reaching for the laurel on the moon
The sky's gate is not closed to you
Suddenly, good word arrives
Everyone smiles at the flower you wear
23.reading: The way up is more open than you think, and good word can arrive when you least expect it. Send the application, proposal or invitation you have been holding today.

24.title: Petals on the Water
verse: No clear reason, no settled home
Drifting like petals on the water
Seeking favor takes hard effort
And still it ends in tangled threads
24.reading: Things feel muddled and you may be drifting with every current right now. Hold off on big decisions today, stay out of gossip, and sort out your own tasks one at a time.

25.title: Past the Worry
verse: Past several rounds of worry and danger
From now, you stand on firm ground
An easy heart finds easy plans
Meet someone wise, and do great work
25.reading: You have come through a stretch of worry and can start building again on steadier footing. Loosen your shoulders today and spend some time talking with someone you trust; a good idea may come from a casual chat.

26.title: A Letter From Afar
verse: Word drifts down and turns to air
A letter arrives from the sky's edge
It promises the honors you hoped for
Yet in the end, it is empty
26.reading: Something that sounds wonderful may be thinner than it looks, and your steady ground matters more than a bright promise. Today, before you count on any offer, ask one clear follow-up question and keep tending your own work.

27.title: Back Against the Mountain
verse: One plan, one use, one written page
You weigh before and after, and hesitate
When the hour comes, help arrives
Like a mountain wall to lean on
27.reading: You've been thinking hard and holding back, and the verse says support tends to appear when the timing is right. Today, write your plan on one page and ask someone you trust for honest feedback before you choose when to move.

28.title: Moon Behind Clouds
verse: In the east the moon rises, lovely
In a moment clouds cover its light
It waxes full, and it wanes
Idle talk is only idle talk
28.reading: Something clear has been briefly clouded over, perhaps by a misunderstanding or loose talk, but the light is still there. Today, resist the urge to explain yourself right away; let things settle and revisit it once the air has cleared.

29.title: The Sword Leaves Its Sheath
verse: A sword drawn from its case shines
Sheathed, it gathered no dust at all
Now a steady hand brings it out
Its edge and bearing earn respect
29.reading: Skills you've kept polished out of sight are ready to be seen, especially alongside someone who believes in you. Today, volunteer for one meaningful task and let people watch you do it well.

30.title: Snake in the Grass
verse: Don't go asking others for favors
A crane flies in; hidden arrows follow
Gather firewood, and a snake waits
Sharp tongues may leave you uneasy
30.reading: This is a moment to move carefully, since not every helping hand or friendly word is what it seems. Today, handle the important things yourself, ask fewer favors, and keep a little back when you speak.

31.title: Tea in a Quiet Corner
verse: Sit at ease in a quiet place
Well fed, sip tea, sit or lie down
Set down body and mind, no rush
No blame or trouble comes calling
31.reading: Nothing here needs to be forced, and calm is your advantage right now. Today, work through your list at an even pace and set aside fifteen minutes for tea and doing nothing.

32.title: Jade Inside the Stone
verse: The road ahead is distant, yet sure
Who knows there is jade within stone
One day a skilled hand splits it open
And the green jade is finally seen
32.reading: Your worth may not be visible yet, but it is real and waiting for the right eyes. Today, polish one skill a little further and share your work with someone who truly knows the craft.

33.title: Treasure Already Within
verse: You carry treasures beyond price
Holding jade, why search outside
Better to wait for a discerning eye
Ease your heart, then ease it more
33.reading: Much of what you're looking for elsewhere is already in you. Today, skip the comparisons, trust what you've built, and give your full attention to the task in front of you.

34.title: Red Sun at Noon
verse: Coming and going with grace and respect
Words loyal and kind, promises kept
When the heart is unclear, let it settle
Like the bright red sun at noon
34.reading: Steady integrity is your strongest footing, and a quiet heart makes the way clear. Today, follow through on one thing you told a friend or teammate you would do.

35.title: Clearing the Thorns
verse: Straighten your robes, renew the old ways
The path seems endless, yet it pays
Sweep the thorns from the road ahead
Three agree, and walk as one again
35.reading: This is a time to regroup, reset, and find common purpose with the people around you. Today, sit down with your team to realign on one goal and clear away a small obstacle together.

36.title: The Monkey Slips Its Chain
verse: Don't fret over the troubles before you
The open ground holds much to gather
Like a monkey slipping its golden chain
Home to its mountain cave, at ease
36.reading: Something that has been weighing on you is less binding than it feels. Today, deal with one task that's been hanging over you, and notice how much lighter you feel afterward.

37.title: Candle in the Wind
verse: Waiting for calm and better days
A candle in the wind won't hold
Better to sit in the inner hall
Where a still flame shines unshaken
37.reading: Pushing hard or standing out right now would only make your light waver. Today, keep a low profile, work quietly at your own rhythm, and skip one unnecessary errand or meeting.

38.title: Moonlight on a Secret Book
verse: Moonlight on a secret book, so still
Then sudden clouds and mist roll in
Ease your heart until the mist lifts
Then is the time to change course
38.reading: The way forward is hidden for a while, and that is no reason to worry. Today, hold off on big changes, rest your mind, and make your next move once things look clear again.

39.title: Polishing Stone Into Mirror
verse: News from far away is hard to read
Don't overthink or force the outcome
Grinding a stone to make a mirror
Only spends your strength in vain
39.reading: Some results simply aren't yours to reach for right now, and straining after them only wears you down. Today, set aside one thing you can't control and spend your energy on something you can.

40.title: Sun Sets, Moon Rises
verse: The red sun sinks in the west
The moon rabbit climbs in the east
Yin grows, yang fades, and things flow
A gentle hand now fills the heart
40.reading: The season around you is shifting, and a softer, more receptive approach suits this turn. Today, adjust one plan to fit the change instead of resisting it, and try a gentler tone in a tricky conversation.

41.title: Sweetness With a Hook
verse: Remember the good advice you've heard
Don't take a thief in as kin
Don't crave the sweetness of the moment
Think how it may look years ahead
41.reading: An offer that looks unusually sweet deserves a second look before you commit. Today, when something seems too generous, take time to learn more about who is offering before you say yes.

42.title: Grace for Every Living Thing
verse: Grace pours down from on high
Ask again; nothing lost, nothing more
All living things share in its blessing
On earth and above, the way opens
42.reading: You are surrounded by more kindness than you may notice, and it flows outward easily now. Today, pass some of it on: call someone in your family or do a friend a small favor.

43.title: All Things Complete
verse: Heaven and earth shift, all things whole
Tend yourself, sustain yourself, find peace
The countless forms of life all shine
Each thing as you wish; give thanks
43.reading: You have what you need to stand on your own and move things forward at your own pace. Today, take one project fully into your own hands, set your own rhythm, and give it your honest best.

44.title: Black and White Board
verse: Two well-matched players face the board
Black and white, the game undecided
A single move decides it all
Find the move that serves you best
44.reading: You are evenly matched with a challenge, and one well-considered step will matter more than many hurried ones. Today, before you act on something competitive, pause to find the single key move and make it with care.

45.title: Spring Water When Thirsty
verse: Gentleness has always outlasted force
A house of kindness thrives and flourishes
Whoever draws this lot today
Finds sweet water in their thirst
45.reading: Softness and goodwill are your real strength now, and they refresh everyone around you. Today, meet a disagreement with patience and one extra measure of understanding.

46.title: Old Tree Flowers Again
verse: Keep patiently to your old path
Hold your heart steady, think no ill
Wait for someone's gentle push
And the old dry branch will bloom
46.reading: This isn't the moment to switch directions; steady work in your current lane is quietly building toward something. Today, do your usual work well and keep an eye out for the person whose small help could make the difference.

47.title: Flowers on Brocade
verse: Flowers on brocade, colors brighter still
Good fortune arrives, joy on both sides
Don't regret that recognition came late
One leap, and the word spreads far
47.reading: Something you've worked toward for a long time is gaining momentum, and late doesn't mean less. Today, give your long-held goal one more determined push.

48.title: The Great Bird Takes Wing
verse: In autumn a small bird becomes a roc
Joyful, it loves to soar and climb
Ten thousand miles into the clouds
No other bird can follow it
48.reading: You are ready for a bigger stretch than you've been allowing yourself. Today, take on one goal slightly beyond your comfort zone and give yourself room to grow into it.

49.title: Water Turned to Ice
verse: Sky cold, earth frozen, water ice
Why grasp for honors now
Better to keep to yourself, sit still
When the time turns, all grows clear
49.reading: Conditions are too cold for forcing hard things forward, and that is a season, not a verdict. Today, prepare quietly for a task you've been pushing, and save the real effort for when things warm up.

50.title: Sails Full of Wind
verse: Lakes and seas are yours to roam
Raise the sail high and steer freely
When the fair wind comes, it carries you
A boat laden with treasures, layer on layer
50.reading: Momentum is on your side, and open water invites you to explore. Today, reach out to someone new or visit a place outside your usual circle, and see what the trip brings.

51.title: A Cool Summer Wind
verse: The longest days of summer burn,
and everyone is worn down by heat.
Yet the world knows how you feel:
a soft breeze comes, and it cools.
51.reading: You may be running hot and restless, but relief tends to arrive once you stop fighting the heat. When irritation rises today, step away for a few minutes and let yourself cool down before you respond.

52.title: Reaching for the Moon
verse: You reach to catch the moon in water,
and after all that work, nothing's there.
Let idle talk and gossip pass,
or you'll wear yourself out alone.
52.reading: You may be pouring effort into something that looks real but can't be held. Today, check whether your goal is concrete, and skip any argument that won't change anything.

53.title: Dragon and Tiger Call
verse: A setback turns into your moment,
dragon and tiger calling in harmony.
The clear sky holds an open road,
and your chance will come again.
53.reading: The last disappointment is not the final word on where you're headed. Today, try the same thing once more, but change one part of how you go about it.

54.title: Treasure in a Dream
verse: You find treasure in a dream
and wake to empty hands.
The hill you dug gave back a hoe;
take another road, with a hand to help.
54.reading: Holding tighter to one plan may only leave you more tired right now. Today, try a different angle on the problem or ask someone to lend a hand, and steady things first.

55.title: Eat When Hungry
verse: Good parents pass down to children and grandchildren;
food and clothing come in plenty.
The elders at home are content;
eat when hungry, sleep when tired.
55.reading: Your life right now is asking for nothing dramatic, just ordinary care done well. Today, put family and daily life first: eat a proper meal and get to bed a little early.

56.title: Stream Over Small Stones
verse: Over small stones the stream runs loud;
under wind and moon, helpers are busy.
Ask which way the road goes,
and don't follow the flowers' scent into the woods.
56.reading: There are good people and good roads around you, but the way forward isn't obvious yet. Today, get clear on where you're going before you start, and notice what's tempting you off course.

57.title: Wind Past the Ear
verse: Gossip is wind passing your ear;
what you need will gather on its own.
Don't keep holding the old story;
your heart and theirs are much alike.
57.reading: Old grievances and chatter are taking up more of your mind than they deserve. Today, let one past slight go, and in a conversation look for the ground you share instead of the point you disagree on.

58.title: Tend Your Own Field
verse: Remember these plain words:
don't chase a new trade far from home.
Keep to the craft you already know;
other roads won't serve you now.
58.reading: Your steadiness right now comes from the work you already know, not from something unfamiliar. Today, skip the side quest and go one level deeper on a thing you're already good at.

59.title: A Tower Ringed by Thorns
verse: You climb the high tower to hide;
thorns grow thick on every side.
The sky is high, the span uncertain;
grab one thing and you may lose two.
59.reading: This is a moment where pushing forward could cost more than it gains. Today, keep a low profile, take no big risks, and look after your own plans first.

60.title: Kindling for the Fire
verse: You carry kindling to fight a fire,
and it burns across three thousand miles.
Rather than chase glory now,
put things away and spare your heart.
60.reading: Some of what you're doing to fix a conflict may be feeding it instead. Today, if tension flares, pause before you answer and give it time to cool.

61.title: Songs Under the Moon
verse: Poems at sunset, songs beneath the moon,
laughing along with the moment's play.
Some meetings can't be avoided;
voices rise together in one song.
61.reading: Connection is finding you through easy, social moments rather than careful planning. Today, relax at whatever gathering you're in and be sincere, because someone may surprise you.

62.title: Danger That Isn't
verse: Dawn and dusk, you're quietly upheld;
what looks like danger isn't danger.
When a trusted guide takes your hand,
good things follow close behind.
62.reading: The problem in front of you may look worse than it actually is. Today, stay calm and bring it to someone you trust, since it may untangle faster than you expect.

63.title: A Needle Lost at Sea
verse: Long ago a needle slipped from the boat;
today you search the sea again.
Even if the needle can be found,
it will cost you time and care.
63.reading: You're trying to recover something lost, and it's possible, but not quick. Today, write out the steps it would take and work through just the first one.

64.title: Fish in the Net
verse: A fish swims in a blue-green pool,
then the net closes on every side.
You search for a way to turn free;
struggling now only stirs up trouble.
64.reading: You may feel hemmed in, and thrashing about would only tangle things further. Today, avoid stirring up conflict and simply watch, quietly, for where the opening is.

65.title: Joy That Isn't Yet
verse: The joy in front of you isn't joy yet;
not in danger, and not at ease.
Why cut flesh to patch a wound?
Keep to the old way and wait.
65.reading: Something may look good on the surface while quietly costing you more than it gives. Today, don't trade a long-term good for a short-term win; hold your ground and wait for a better time.

66.title: Frost at Dusk
verse: The road is steep, the horse is tired,
the troops are scattered and worn.
High waves split the oar and boat;
at dusk, flowers fade and frost comes down.
66.reading: This stretch is rough on several fronts at once, and that's a reason to slow down, not to push. Today, rest and restock, and set out again only when you're properly ready.

67.title: A Golden Scale
verse: A golden thread weighs your heart:
no more, no less, not light or heavy.
Live upright all your days,
and your gifts will shine on their own.
67.reading: Your fairness and honesty are the strongest things you have going right now. Today, when you make a call, treat everyone evenly and stick to the facts; people notice.

68.title: Joy at the Gate
verse: Good news gathers at your door;
a house of kindness grows bright.
Plans and harvests come together,
and what aches finds its remedy.
68.reading: Good things are growing out of the kindness you and those around you have built up. Today, gather with family or friends, share a piece of good news, and pass the good mood along.

69.title: Plum on a Winter Ridge
verse: Winter comes; one plum branch on the ridge,
leaves gone, wood bare, yet unbroken.
When spring arrives in a hurry,
it blooms first among all flowers.
69.reading: If you're in a low season, it is a season, not a verdict. Today, don't give up on the thing you care about; do one small thing to keep it alive until warmer days.

70.title: The Restless Bee
verse: Day after day, like a bee for flowers,
you fly southwest, then off to the east.
Spring ends, the blossoms fall and vanish,
yet you keep the same old route.
70.reading: Running in many directions may be leaving you tired with little to show for it. Today, stop and name the one thing you actually want, and put your energy there.

71.title: Two Arrows, One Bow
verse: You see a dragon at the crossroads,
a heart pulled between two homes.
One bow strung with two arrows,
and the horse can't settle down.
71.reading: You may be trying to keep two options alive, and it's keeping you unsettled. Today, compare them honestly side by side, then choose one and give it your full effort.

72.title: Honey and the Sting
verse: To get the honey, you go to the hive,
but fear the needle in its tail.
Another path may open before you,
yet in the dark, thorns grow thick.
72.reading: An opportunity that looks sweet may carry a cost you haven't seen yet. Today, ask a few more questions about it and understand the price before you decide.

73.title: Spring Thunder Wakes
verse: Spring thunder rolls, and the insects sing;
with one turn you rise from the mud.
Now you see how comings and goings work;
in a single morning, you become a dragon.
73.reading: The ground under you is waking up, and the change you've been waiting on is ready to move. Today, take one bold, concrete step toward the thing you've wanted to start.

74.title: A Bird Into the Cage
verse: Like a swan that flies into a cage,
you try to turn, but find no way.
North, south, east, west, each door is hard;
this is a time to wait.
74.reading: You may have walked into a tight spot, and forcing your way out now would only make it tighter. Today, hold off on bold moves or new promises, and take time to see clearly where you stand.

75.title: Carrying a Tiger Uphill
verse: Like carrying a tiger over a high mountain,
trembling, your courage gone cold.
Then, without warning, good things turn up;
still, keep yourself safe and steady.
75.reading: You're under real pressure, and careful, steady steps are what will carry you through it. Today, take things in order and protect your footing; a turn for the better may be just one step ahead.

76.title: The Carp in Deep Water
verse: Fish and dragons swim in one pond,
so keep still in the deep water.
One morning your head breaks the surface
and you leap the gate of dragons.
76.reading: You are in an ordinary spot among many others, and your moment hasn't arrived yet. Today, do the unglamorous work in front of you steadily and let your strength quietly build.

77.title: Fame Beyond the Clouds
verse: In dreams you speak of great riches,
and fame drifts far beyond the clouds.
Long rivers and distant mountains blur the truth;
a wise word makes you smile again.
77.reading: Big dreams are floating out of reach right now, too far away to act on. Today, turn one plan into a single first step, and listen openly if someone offers advice.

78.title: Water Just Warm
verse: Cold water, not yet brought to boil,
rests neither cold nor hot, just warm.
To walk the world you need nothing else
when a hundred skills live in your hands.
78.reading: You're at a good, balanced point, and what you carry inside is your real strength. Today, spend some time learning or sharpening one skill so you feel steady wherever you go.

79.title: The Unpaid Promise
verse: You made a wish to stay safe,
and safe you stayed, but never repaid.
Do not forget what you once vowed;
a promise is not a light thing.
79.reading: Some promise you made, maybe a small one, is still waiting to be kept. Today, look over what you've told others you'd do and follow through on at least one of them.

80.title: Sun and Moon Shine Clear
verse: You climbed the high cliffs seeking wisdom
when a call came from an unexpected door.
Sun and moon keep shining in clear skies;
an honest name travels across four seas.
80.reading: You're walking one path, and an opening may appear from a direction you weren't watching. Today, keep doing things the honest way and stay ready to say yes when a good chance shows up.

81.title: Fair Wind Home
verse: Parasol leaves fall as autumn closes,
and the traveler drifts homeward like a cloud.
The sky lends a strong and steady wind,
carrying a boat full of treasures home.
81.reading: A season of effort is winding down, and the wind is at your back. Today, wrap up one thing you've finished, write down what you learned, and let others see the work.

82.title: A Lotus in the Fire
verse: Fierce flames climb into the sky,
yet a lotus blooms inside the fire.
In the end it comes to no harm,
still growing leaves, roots, and branches.
82.reading: Things around you may feel heated, but what matters to you is not being destroyed. Today, when pressure rises, slow your breathing and respond one step at a time.

83.title: Waiting for the Full Moon
verse: Like the moon on its third night,
half there, half missing, not yet whole.
Wait for the fifteenth's gentle evening,
when light and fullness reach everywhere.
83.reading: What you're working on is only halfway formed, and that's simply where it is in its cycle. Today, take the next ordinary step and let it grow toward complete in its own time.

84.title: Dreaming Under the Pines
verse: Trading good character for a name,
even good fortune can turn around.
Drunk, you lose track of the road,
dreaming hazily in the pine shade.
84.reading: Right now it's easy to get swept up in image, noise, or other people's expectations and lose your footing. Today, keep a clear head, skip one optional social obligation, and don't make big decisions in the heat of the moment.

85.title: Fog on the Mountain Road
verse: Dark clouds and fog veil the mountain road;
still the moon returns to full.
Wake from the long dream through your books,
and a guide will lead you higher.
85.reading: The way ahead isn't clear yet, and pushing blindly won't help. Today, invest in yourself by reading or learning something useful, and notice who around you might point the way.

86.title: Thunder on Open Ground
verse: Spring flowers blaze across the terrace,
and carts roll in from far away.
Leap the three great waves at the gate,
like thunder breaking on open ground.
86.reading: Energy is gathering around you, and this is a moment to make your move. Today, give your full effort to the exam, pitch, or presentation that matters most.

87.title: Halfway Up at Sunset
verse: Halfway up the ridge, the sun sinks low;
steep cliffs offer no easy rest.
Look up, the sky still watches over you,
and you are standing on safe ground.
87.reading: You're in a tiring stretch, with the hardest part of the climb still around you. Today, slow down, focus on your next secure step, and reach out to someone who has your back.

88.title: The Wooden Tiger
verse: A tiger carved of wood guards the door,
fierce to look at, harmless to touch.
There is truly nothing here to fear;
only worry makes the heart jump.
88.reading: Something or someone looks more threatening than it actually is. Today, before reacting, take a calm second look and check the facts.

89.title: Jade Inside the Stone
verse: Your comings and goings move with ease,
like flawless jade hidden in stone.
When a wise friend shows you where to look,
the treasure shines and brings you joy.
89.reading: There is real value in something you have that hasn't been seen yet, maybe not even by you. Today, ask someone you trust to look over your work and point out what you might be missing.

90.title: A Letter on the Wind
verse: Suddenly good news takes to the sky,
and a boat comes home full of treasure.
Ask about the road ahead: it is kind,
with helping hands still waiting further on.
90.reading: Momentum is on your side, and support is closer than you think. Today, move forward on something you've been waiting to start, and reach out to one person who can help.

91.title: Road Wide as Sky
verse: Smooth out your worried brow and step forward;
the road ahead is turning bright.
A great path opens, wide as the sky,
and open hands make an open heart.
91.reading: The worries that held you back are loosening, and the way forward is wider than it looks. Today, take one step you've been hesitating on, and share something generously with someone.

92.title: Student Returns a Master
verse: Since youth you've planned and built with care;
what you need comes without chasing it.
Plan your hopes together with a partner;
you leave a student, return a master.
92.reading: Your steady planning and effort have been adding up, even when you couldn't see it. Today, sketch out one long-term goal and choose a small action that moves it forward.

93.title: Rain on Phoenix Feathers
verse: The phoenix's feathers drip with rain,
and for now the sparrows mock it.
One day the clouds will clear,
and it will smooth its wings again.
93.reading: You may feel underestimated or treated unfairly right now, and it stings. Today, don't let it sink in too deep; take care of yourself first and trust that you'll have room to spread out again.

94.title: The Zither and the Listener
verse: Don't stoop to petty people's ways;
when things slip, blame flies everywhere.
A zither's song needs an ear that understands;
keep steady and quiet, and calm returns.
94.reading: There's friction or misunderstanding around you, and arguing it out won't settle much. Today, step back from who's right and wrong, and spend time talking with one friend who really gets you.

95.title: When the Golden Rooster Crows
verse: Ambition is built one morning at a time;
too much wine and pleasure wears it down.
When the golden rooster calls the dawn,
good things come out to meet you.
95.reading: Distractions and easy comforts are quietly draining the energy your goals need. Today, cut back on one indulgence and get up early to do the single most important task first.

96.title: The Shining Pagoda
verse: A towering pagoda, unlike any other,
gleams with light on all eight sides.
Set your heart and practice with devotion;
do good, and blessings find their way.
96.reading: Kindness and steady intention are your brightest qualities right now. Today, do one small good thing for a coworker or a stranger, and notice how it lifts your own mood too.

97.title: Flowers in a Mirror
verse: A candle lit in the wind throws thin shadows,
blurring like flowers in a mirror.
You keep tidying it, again and again,
not seeing it's only a drifting raft.
97.reading: Some of what's keeping you busy looks lively but may not lead anywhere real. Today, drop one task that's just for show and give that energy to a goal that truly matters.

98.title: A Bird Near the Net
verse: In your plans and travels, go slowly;
rushing and fretting only stir up trouble.
Like a bird that flies into a net,
it takes time to find the way out.
98.reading: Things feel tangled right now, and hurrying will likely tighten the knot. Today, hold off on launching anything new, keep your emotions steady, and step away from arguments until the picture clears.

99.title: Rain After the Fire
verse: Reins in hand, you charge straight ahead,
half into worry, half into trouble.
Like a house where fire takes hold,
until the season's rain falls and cools it.
99.reading: Pushing hard right now may run you into more than you expected. Today, ease off the charge, prepare a backup plan for one important thing, and remember that difficult stretches do pass.

100.title: Keep the Old Path
verse: The signs have spoken plainly to you;
the restless mind talks itself into fog.
The elder takes the lot and walks home,
keeping old ways until the time comes.
100.reading: Overthinking and hurrying are clouding your view more than any outside problem. Today, avoid big changes, keep your current rhythm, and let the right moment come to you.

1.say: This is a low stretch, so pushing hard may drain you; hold steady for now.
do: Put big decisions on hold for now
Talk it through with someone you trust

2.say: Momentum is slow right now, so effort may stretch thin; build your energy first.
do: Skip new projects; focus on one or two
Rest, move your body, and leave some slack

3.say: Neither good nor bad, just steady; daily effort is what carries you.
do: Do the work in front of you well
Keep regular hours and leave room to breathe

4.say: Things lean your way, but the momentum still needs your push.
do: Set one goal this month; check it weekly
Say yes to a good fit, then adjust

5.say: Your energy is strong and efforts tend to land; a good time to go bold.
do: Revive a shelved plan; start with the top one
Reach out to people who can help you
